description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_CarService" name="Car Service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CarService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ServiceDue</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueFine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Driver" name="Driver">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeCarToService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Pay</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ServiceCompletedStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTimeInitial</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterNextServiceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ServiceCompletedStart" name="Service completed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_EnterInitialTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextServiceTimeInitial" name="Enter time for next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_EnterInitialTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialTime_ServiceDue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ServiceDue" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialTime_ServiceDue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NextTime_ServiceDue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ServiceDue_CheckRegistration</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_ServiceDue">
        <bpmn:timeDate xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${nextServiceTime}</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check whether car is registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ServiceDue_CheckRegistration</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckRegistration_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registration" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckRegistration_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Registered</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Notify" name="Notify driver">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Registered</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_AttendGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AttendService" name="Go to the service?" default="Flow_DoesNotAttend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_AttendGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Attends</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DoesNotAttend</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeCarToService" name="Take car to service facility">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Attends</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TakeCar_EnterProblems</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TakeCar_EnterProblems</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Problems_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Repair and provide status updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Problems_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Repair</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Updates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Repair</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Repair_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveUpdates" name="Receive status updates via email while waiting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Updates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Updates_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Repair done and updates received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Repair_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Updates_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Pay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Pay" name="Pay through the app">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Pay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Pay_RecordSuccess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Pay_RecordSuccess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordSuccess_EnterNextTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" name="Enter time for next service">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordSuccess_EnterNextTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NextTime_ServiceDue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ThirtyDays" name="30 days elapse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DoesNotAttend</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ThirtyDays_IssueFine</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ThirtyDays_IssueFine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_IssueFine_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fined" name="Driver fined">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_IssueFine_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotRegistered</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterInitialTime" sourceRef="Event_ServiceCompletedStart" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTimeInitial"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialTime_ServiceDue" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTimeInitial" targetRef="Event_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextTime_ServiceDue" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime" targetRef="Event_ServiceDue"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ServiceDue_CheckRegistration" sourceRef="Event_ServiceDue" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckRegistration_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registration" targetRef="Task_Notify">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registration" targetRef="EndEvent_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_AttendGateway" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Gateway_AttendService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Attends" name="Goes to service" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Task_TakeCarToService">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${attendsService}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DoesNotAttend" name="Does not go to service" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendService" targetRef="Event_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeCar_EnterProblems" sourceRef="Task_TakeCarToService" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Problems_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Repair" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Repair_Join" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Pay" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pay_RecordSuccess" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordSuccess_EnterNextTime" sourceRef="Task_RecordSuccessfulRepair" targetRef="Task_EnterNextServiceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ThirtyDays_IssueFine" sourceRef="Event_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_IssueFine_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="EndEvent_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
